language.label: Console language
language.note: Changes this console only. What the bot replies in is set per script.

warning.empty: No text was found. Nothing would be ingested.
warning.no_sentence_boundaries: No sentence ends were found, so the whole document became one chunk. A table exported to plain text does this, and every search then returns all of it.
warning.oversized: One chunk is far larger than the target and will rank against everything.
warning.bare_figures: Figures here carry no currency or unit — a column whose header row did not come with it. The bot cannot label these numbers.

inbox.orphan: No source. The bot would not have sent this.

gate.numeric_grounding: Every figure traced to a source
gate.figure_audit: Every figure labelled as its source labels it
gate.degraded: The labelling check could not run — this passed by default
